transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you all know, Paint Booth 4 was stopped this morning after solvent was found pooled beneath its circulation manifold. The booth is currently isolated from production and the spill area has been cordoned off. Per our standard incident-review practice, I need to hear findings from maintenance, environmental compliance, production, and quality before I can issue any safety authorization for containment, restart, or recovery. Let's get started -- who would like to report first?
